title: Mal Hallett's comeback band with Gene Krupa
summary: Leeman saw Hallett's theatre band with Frankie Carle, Toots Mondello and Gene Krupa playing loud brushes.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Oh yes, Franklie Carle on piano, and at one time when he made a comeback, he had Frankie Carle, and he had Gene Krupa with him.
He organized his band, they did theatres. And I went and saw those -- I saw, had all those things at my disposal. Gene Krupa played nothing but brushes, but loud. That was the thing.
Gene Krupa broke down the barrier for drummers with sticks, eventually, but he played with that
band, with Buddy Rogers' orchestra. Then there was Toots Mondello, a great saxophone player.
